newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - RBA's Fraser sees small budget economy impact.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - RBA's Fraser sees small budget economy impact.

text.p: Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) governor Bernie Fraser said the Australian government's spending reductions in the current 1996/1997 financial year should not have a major impact on economic activity.

"We couldn't expect these kinds of reductions in the budget deficit, government spending, to have serious implications for economic acitivity as long as there is confidence and buoyancy in the private sector and there is in Australia," Fraser said.
He said this confidence would more than offset the contraction that may have arisen from lower spending.
